# AURA SPACE — Complete Reference (llms-full.txt)

Canonical URL: https://auraspace.cafe/
Last updated: 2026-11-19

## 1. Flagship Store: AURA CAFE Sa Đéc
- **Name**: AURA CAFE (AURA SPACE)
- **Address**: 29 Nguyễn Tất Thành, Phường 1, TP. Sa Đéc, Đồng Tháp, Vietnam (opposite Thảo Trâm 2 Hotel)
- **Hours**: 07:00 – 23:00 daily (Monday–Sunday)
- **Phone**: +84 946 013 633
- **Architecture**: 3 recycled shipping containers forming 5 distinct zones: Quầy Bar Container, Lounge Thủy Mộc, Sân Thượng Rooftop, Phòng Container 40ft (air-conditioned quiet work cabin), and Khu Sofa / Sân Vườn.
- **Services**: Dine-in with QR table ordering, online table reservation, local Sa Đéc delivery, acoustic events, and AURA Points loyalty program.

## 2. AURA SPACE SaaS v3.0 (F&B Commercial Operating System)
AURA SPACE powers coffee shops, tea houses, bistros, and multi-branch F&B chains with zero order commission — customer payments settle directly into each merchant's own bank account (VietQR) or own PayOS merchant account (AES-256-GCM encrypted credentials).

### Plans & Pricing (VND)
- **Starter** — 199,000 VND/month (1,910,400 VND/year, -20%): Up to 15 tables, 3 staff accounts, QR table ordering, `/s/:slug` storefront, POS, KDS, thermal printing, direct VietQR.
- **Pro (Recommended)** — 499,000 VND/month (4,790,400 VND/year, -20%): Everything in Starter plus BOM recipe & inventory tracking, P&L reporting, CRM & loyalty campaigns, merchant-owned PayOS integration, Custom Domain (DNS TXT verified), up to 50 tables and 15 staff accounts.
- **Chain** — 1,290,000 VND/month (12,384,000 VND/year, -20%): Everything in Pro with unlimited tables and staff, multi-branch HQ rollup, AI analytics, and ERP/Zalo integrations.

### Trial & Onboarding
- **Free trial**: 14 days full-access trial, no credit card required, 3-day grace window, safe read-only fallback with full JSON data export at any time.
- **60-second signup**: Visit `https://auraspace.cafe/signup` to choose a store slug (`/s/:slug`), pick a starter menu template (Coffee, Milk Tea, Bistro), and launch immediately.
